purpose: Targeted source-evidence audit of the sole unresolved reconstruction candidate R-077. Compares the inherited bad reference and thematically plausible source texts without assigning a replacement identity absent provenance proof.

subject.inheritedAuditSummaryFr: Transmission sur la miséricorde envers les créatures et la miséricorde d’Allah.

verifiedComparisons.sourceFinding: Hadith of Aisha about Jibril repeatedly recommending the neighbor.
verifiedComparisons.reason: The subject does not match the inherited mercy summary.

verifiedComparisons.sourceFinding: Narrated by Jarir bin Abdullah; mercy toward mankind is linked to Allah showing mercy.
verifiedComparisons.reason: Thematic fit does not prove that R-077 is a duplicate of the already assigned R-045.

verifiedComparisons.sourceFinding: Narrated by Abdullah bin Amr; the merciful are shown mercy by Ar-Rahman and are commanded to show mercy on earth.
verifiedComparisons.reason: No inherited narrator, wording, route, or alternate reference links R-077 to this transmission.

verifiedComparisons.sourceFinding: Narrated by Abu Huraira; Allah created one hundred mercies and sent one part among all creatures.
verifiedComparisons.reason: The inherited summary is too generic to distinguish this family from other mercy traditions.

verifiedComparisons.sourceFinding: Abu Huraira route in the hundred-mercies family; one mercy is among creation while the remainder is reserved by Allah.
verifiedComparisons.reason: No provenance field in R-077 identifies this collection, narrator, or wording.

verifiedComparisons.sourceFinding: Salman al-Farisi route in the hundred-mercies family; one mercy underlies mutual mercy among creation and ninety-nine are reserved for the Day of Resurrection.
verifiedComparisons.reason: The summary alone cannot identify this distinct route.
